Warrior.p: Greataxe-Tank mit enormem Vorwärtsdruck, hoher Selbstheilung und wuchtigen Flächenangriffen. Kämpft körperlich, direkt und aggressiv an der Front.
Warrior.m: dark forged metal, rugged leather, heavy woven cloth and reinforced straps
Warrior.c: strong fitted combat harness / cuirass, layered hip armor, bracers, reinforced boots and a large two-handed axe
Warrior.s: wide grounded stance with the axe drawn across the body, shoulders engaged and torso leaning subtly into the next decisive strike

Weaver.m: silk, linen, velvet, fine wool, embroidered trim and polished wood loom components
Weaver.c: fitted blouse / bodice with elegant rolled sleeves, layered apron-skirt or tailored trousers, measuring tape, thread spools and textile tools
Weaver.s: graceful work posture at a loom or cutting table, one hand guiding fabric tension while the other aligns thread or shears

White Mage.p: Direkter Heilmagier mit starker Wiederherstellung, Licht- und Naturmagie. Stabilisiert Einzelziele und Gruppen mit klarer, kraftvoller Heilwirkung.
White Mage.m: layered ivory caster cloth, soft satin, embroidered trim, polished light-metal fittings
White Mage.c: fitted healer bodice with split robe panels, shoulder drape, gloves, waist sash and a compact staff / cane focus
White Mage.s: open three-quarter support stance, one foot advanced, staff angled across the body while the free hand shapes a controlled restorative effect

Wizard.m: dense caster textile, satin lining, dark leather, velvet trim and polished magical fittings
Wizard.c: fitted caster coat, structured bodice, layered split robe panels, gloves, tall boots and a long staff
Wizard.s: grounded casting stance with staff and free hand coordinated around a clear elemental spell objective

If it specifies crouching, leaning, reclining, walking, running, airborne, braced or another posture, preserve that posture.

Use standing only when the Pokédex itself specifies standing.

Furniture and environment interactions are binding pose constraints.

A heroine assigned to sit at a table, work from a stool, lean over a counter, kneel beside equipment, brace against terrain or otherwise physically interact with the scene must visibly perform that exact posture relationship.

Use the Pokédex CAMERA and FRAMING exactly as the composition authority.

The Core may protect:

- facial readability
- material clarity
- anatomy
- heroine prominence

inside that prescribed composition, but it must not replace the camera, crop, distance or posture to achieve them.

The Core never supplies a fallback pose when the Pokédex already provides one.

---

13. SOURCE COLOR AUTHORITY

The source artwork and Pokédex define the palette.

Preserve:

- primary source color as a large readable mass
- major secondary colors
- distinctive accent colors
- species markings
- species motifs

Avoid:

- gray wash
- beige contamination
- accidental yellow / orange cast
- pastel drift
- generic gold grading
- overexposure that erases local color

White-dominant heroines still require strong secondary and accent colors.

Environmental light may influence local colors but must not replace them.

---

14. MATERIAL SPECIFICITY

Use the Pokédex material recipe exactly.

Major garment masses should resolve as:

- specific color
- specific material
- specific finish

Show:

- thickness
- seams
- edge finishing
- fold behavior
- tactile texture
- material-specific gloss / roughness
- jewelry response
- hardware response

Do not make everything glossy.

Do not make everything matte.

Profession materials and species materials should remain visually distinguishable while belonging to the same garment system.

---

15. HAND / LIMB INTEGRITY

Unless explicitly specified otherwise:

- exactly two arms
- exactly two hands
- five fingers per visible hand
- coherent palm / thumb placement
- believable wrist connection
- clear ownership of each hand by the correct arm

Never allow:

- extra floating hand
- third hand
- duplicated arm
- disembodied fingers
- hand emerging from fur
- hand emerging from cape
- hand emerging from weapon
- hand emerging from barrier
- hand emerging from prop
- hand emerging from background
- fused digits
- duplicated digits
- broken grip geometry

If a complex finger gesture threatens anatomy, simplify the finger pose while preserving the professional action.

Professional interaction takes priority over decorative hand posing.

---

16. SPECIES RECOGNITION

At normal viewing size, preserve at least three coordinated Pokémon-derived cues through:

- color placement
- material / surface identity
- silhouette rhythm
- wearable appendage-motif logic (garment / accessory / equipment only)
- marking rhythm
- signature accessories
- controlled species effects

The result should remain recognizable without relying on literal animal anatomy. No species appendage may become a biological ear, tail, horn, wing, fin, paw, claw or other attached creature body part.

Species recognition must come primarily through coordinated design translation rather than mascot-like decoration.

---

17. PROFESSIONAL ACTION PRIORITY

The concrete Pokédex professional scene must remain immediately readable.

The heroine must visibly perform the assigned task.

Do not convert professional scenes into passive glamour portraits.

Glamour must be integrated into the prescribed action through:

- posture
- asymmetry
- torso orientation
- gaze
- wardrobe presentation
- framing
- lighting

without replacing the job itself.

Tools must be:

- logically placed
- held correctly when in active use
- materially integrated
- appropriate to the assigned profession

The environment should visibly support the profession.

---

18. SINGLE-SCENE VISUAL COHERENCE

Every individual generated artwork must depict one unified spatial event.

All visible elements must share:

- the same perspective system
- the same lighting environment
- the same moment
- the same architectural space
- coherent spatial relationships

The heroine, patient, tools, furniture and environment must physically inhabit the same scene.

Do not introduce isolated secondary compositions or unrelated visual inserts.

---

19. FINAL GOLD CHECK

Before finalizing each individual image:

1. unmistakably adult heroine
2. one continuous 9:16 artwork
3. one primary heroine
4. one coherent scene
5. 4K-equivalent portrait-wallpaper intent
6. premium anime-fantasy DIGITAL ART
7. heroine large enough for strong facial and costume readability
8. clear cinematic spatial depth
9. exact Pokédex outfit obeyed
10. exact professional scene obeyed
11. exact action family visibly readable
12. prescribed pose respected
13. prescribed camera respected
14. prescribed framing respected
15. tasteful erotic allure
16. correct evolution / prestige strength
17. bust anatomically integrated
18. source colors remain readable
19. differentiated premium materials
20. exactly two arms and two hands unless explicitly specified otherwise
21. at least three readable species cues
22. no unintended previous-generation anchoring
23. no sibling-output anchoring
24. no competing visual composition inside the artwork
25. for active Generations 4, 5, 8 and 9: exactly one visible person / humanoid character — the current heroine

Deliver ONE finished Novaris Gold-Baseline key artwork for this individual generation.

When an external Output Mode requests several artworks, repeat the entire individual-generation process independently for every requested output.
